SOLARSYSTEMRESTRICTIVEDECLARATION This SOLAR SYSTEM RESTRICTIVE DECLARATION (this“Declaration")made this 27th day of July, 2026, by AMSTERDAM GARVEY HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND CORPORATION, a New York not-for-profit corporation, having its principal office at c/o West Harlem Group Assistance, Inc., 1652 Amsterdam Avenue, New York, New York 10031 (the "Declarant"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Declarant is the fee title owner of those certain parcels of land commonly known as (i) Block 1988, Lot 105, County of New York, City and State of New York, and as and bythestreet address1524AmsterdamAvenue(saidparcelofland,togetherwiththebuildings and improvements now or hereafter located thereon, hereinafter referred to as the “1524 Property"); (ii) Block 1988, Lot 106, County of New York, City and State of New York, and as and by the street address 1528 Amsterdam Avenue (said parcel of land, together with the buildings and improvements now or hereafter located thereon, hereinafter referred to as the “1528 Property", together with the 1524 Property, collectively, the “Amsterdam Properties"), as more particularly described on Schedule 1 attached hereto and made a part hereof; WHEREAS, with respect to the 1528 Property, Declarant has requested the New York City Department of Buildings ("DOB") to act upon Application No. M01377419-I1 to alter on the 1528 Property, a residential building (the“Application"); WHEREAS, the Amsterdam Properties shall be serviced by one (1) solar panel system consisting of two (2) solar arrays wired in conjunction to act as one (1) array,with one (1) inverter, and one (1) riser connected to one (1) Public Light and Power (*"PLP") meter at the 1528 Property hereof; WHEREAS, the Solar System shall be located within the bounds of the Amsterdam Properties, as all such elements of which are shown with particular detail on those certain approved plans onrecordwith theDOB; WHEREAS, the Declarant seeks to provide the Amsterdam Properties the access rights necessary for the installation, operation, maintenance, and repair of the Solar System; and WHEREAS,the Declarant wishes to ensure that the use of the Solar System may be enjoyed by all of the Amsterdam Properties. NOW, THEREFORE, the Declarant for itself, and its heirs, successors and assigns, does hereby covenant and declare as follows: 1. Upon no less than three (3) day's notice except in the event of an emergency whereupon no notice shall be required, current and future owners of the 1524 Property, and their successors, heirs, and assigns, shall have the right to enter upon the 1528 Property with

workers, materials, vehicles, and equipment as is reasonably necessary for the purpose of installing, using, operating, maintaining, and repairing the arrays, the inverter, the riser, and the interconnection to the PLP meter of the Solar System. 2. The Solar System shall be maintained and kept in good repair. 3.This Declaration shall survive any sale or transfer of the Amsterdam Properties, and shall survive if the 1524 Property and the 1528 Property are owned separately. 4.Any nuisance due to the use of the Solar System that would have an adverse effect on the health, safety, and welfare of the City of New York shall be promptly abated. 5.The covenants set forth herein shall run with the land and shall bind Declarant, present owner(s) of the Amsterdam Properties and any and all subsequent owners, heirs, legal 6. This Declaration is subject to the approval of the DOB, and may not be amended or terminated without the prior written consent of the DOB. 7. Failure to comply with the terms of this Declaration may result in the revocation of a building permit or certificate of occupancy of the Amsterdam Properties by the DOB. 8.This Declaration shall be recorded at the Office of the City Register against all affected parcels of land and the cross-reference number and title of the Declaration shall be recorded on each temporary and permanent certificate of occupancy hereafter issued to the buildings located on the affected parcels and in any deed for conveyance thereof.
